criteria.expected: If registering a communication fact, use the existing exact original communication/evidence/context and applicable review/version/party guards; a generic work result cannot be mislabeled a communication fact.

criteria.expected: An existing uncertain attempt remains uncertain without reliable authorized exact observation; timeout, lease expiry and manual permission cannot prove no prior effect.

criteria.expected: Exact replay is idempotent; changed result or mismatched original identity is rejected or creates the existing review conflict, never silently overwrites historical success.

criteria.expected: Post-reconciliation comparisons classify exact mutable changes and preserve immutable historical rows, approved material, previous claims, role/ACL authority and other resources.
